decisive_items: biopsy results were consistent with adipose tissue
a 6 cm mass arising from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum
response.rationale: Fat attenuation on CT and biopsy-proven adipose tissue are definitive for gastric lipoma; the submucosal/muscularis propria location and bleeding are compatible but not specific.

rejected.why: Although GIST can arise from the muscularis propria, the predominantly fat attenuation and adipose tissue on biopsy are not features of GIST and strongly favor lipoma.
